quality.review_scope: Independent R1 source audit of all three supplied main pages, both figures, six-row table, equation1 and ten bibliographic entries passed. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: All three supplied main pages, two figures, unnumbered six-row table, equation1 and ten bibliography entries read; SI and cited full texts unreviewed.

Reagent amounts, resin mass/exchange capacity, ammonia concentration/dose, precipitation pH/time, agitation rates, centrifuge speed/time, wash volumes/repetitions, ramp and pressure are unreported. The source0.013M concentration applies to ion-exchanged sol preparation, not automatically to the ammonia reference.

The100mL PTFE vessel and40% fill describe the sol method. Suspension controls are said to use similar conditions; their independently specified vessel/fill details are absent. No40mL delivered aliquot or pressure is calculated.

XRD coherent-scattering-domain sizes, TEM means/ranges and optical-derived sizes are distinct. Primarily hexagonal particle outlines do not establish a hexagonal crystal phase; no crystallographic phase or measured atomic coordinates are supplied.

The initial sol and suspension table rows use a dash for microwave temperature. This means untreated precursor context, not zero degrees. XRD <5nm is strict; table TEM4nm and prose3–5nm/4–5nm are retained separately.

Longer microwave duration to6h is reported for some experiments, with unchanged suspension CSD, but exact temperatures and sample identities are absent. Ordinary hydrothermal treatment is reported without a complete temperature/time matrix; no guessed cross-product of conditions.
Source text describes virtually nonaggregated or loosely aggregated particles; no independent physical batch or inter-technique aliquot identity is supplied.
Full molecular/crystal presentation remains pending; source-qualified identity references and conceptual hardware are not measured coordinates.
